articles.title: What a British think tank gets wrong about Russia’s ultimate weapons
articles.summary: The Royal United Services Institute (RUSI) recently published a report, ‘Russia’s Nuclear Deterrent and Its Weapons Procurement’, analyzing Russia's evolving nuclear capabilities and strategic acquisitions. For SSB aspirants, this report is vital for understanding global defence dynamics, superpower strategies, and their implications for international security and India's geopolitical standing.
